title: Learning to Curate What You Generate for Generalizable Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
title_zh: 学习如何筛选生成内容：面向可泛化的少样本增量类学习

paragraphs.en: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn novel classes from limited annotations while preserving prior knowledge. Existing methods typically assume a sufficiently large base session, but this assumption fails when both base and incremental data are scarce, leading to weak initial representations, semantic drift, and unstable boundaries. We study this underexplored yet realistic setting, termed Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL), where the base session itself contains only a few classes. Although synthetic data can alleviate supervision scarcity, naively mixing generated samples often introduces semantic noise and exacerbates old–new boundary conflicts. To address this, we propose a framework that curates trustworthy synthetic knowledge for stable G-FSCIL. Specifically, we first construct class-specific synthetic candidate pools using a frozen latent diffusion model, where class inversion is performed at the first observation and the resulting condition embeddings are reused for on-demand generation. Building on these candidates, we learn a knowledge curation strategy that selects samples with both semantic consistency and visual diversity, and distill this process into a transferable selection policy during the base session, which is then reused without further optimization. Leveraging the curated synthetic data, we further design a boundary-stable incremental adaptation scheme, including synthetic-informed prototype initialization and bidirectional boundary calibration to mitigate old–new conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing FSCIL baselines, with reduced forgetting and improved balance between old and new classes. Code is available at https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL .
paragraphs.zh: 小样本增量分类学习（FSCIL）旨在通过有限的标注学习新类别，同时保留先验知识。 现有方法通常假设存在足够大的基础会话，但当基础数据和增量数据均稀缺时，这一假设不再成立，从而导致初始表示较弱、语义漂移和边界不稳定。 我们研究了这一尚未被充分探索但具有现实意义的场景，即“可泛化的 FSCIL”（G-FSCIL），其中基础会话本身仅包含少数类别。 尽管合成数据可以缓解标注稀缺的问题，但直接混合生成的样本往往会引入语义噪声，并加剧新旧类别之间的边界冲突。 为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种框架，用于构建可靠的合成知识，以实现稳定的 G-FSCIL。 具体而言，我们首先使用一个冻结的潜在扩散模型构建每个类别特定的合成候选池，其中在首次观察时执行类别反转，并将生成的条件嵌入重复用于按需生成。 基于这些候选样本，我们学习了一种知识筛选策略，以选择兼具语义一致性和视觉多样性的样本，并在基础会话期间将这一过程提炼为可迁移的选择策略，之后无需进一步优化即可重复使用。 利用筛选后的合成数据，我们进一步设计了一种边界稳定的增量适应方案，包括基于合成数据的原型初始化和双向边界校准，以缓解新旧类别之间的冲突。 大量实验表明，我们的方法在性能上持续优于现有的 FSCIL 基线模型，同时减少了知识遗忘，并改善了新旧类别之间的平衡。 代码可在 https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL 获取。

paragraphs.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has enabled deep neural networks to achieve remarkable success in visual recognition tasks ( Yin et al., 2026 ) . However, most models follow a static paradigm with all categories available simultaneously during training. In real-world environments, new categories continually emerge over time, requiring models to incrementally acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned information. Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) ( Rebuffi et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2022c ) addresses this challenge by enabling models to learn new classes without retraining from scratch. In practice, however, newly introduced classes are often associated with only a handful of labeled samples. This limitation motivates Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , which aims to incrementally learn novel classes from extremely limited supervision while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Compared to standard CIL, FSCIL is more vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting ( McCloskey and Cohen, 1989 ) and overfitting ( Chen et al., 2019 ) , due to both scarce data and repeated updates.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能的快速发展使得深度神经网络在视觉识别任务中取得了显著成功（Yin 等，2026）。 然而，大多数模型遵循静态范式，在训练期间所有类别均可同时使用。 在真实环境中，新类别会随着时间的推移不断出现，这要求模型在保留先前所学知识的同时逐步获取新知识。 类别增量学习（CIL）（Rebuffi 等，2017；Wang 等，2022c）通过使模型无需从头重新训练即可学习新类别来解决这一挑战。 然而在实践中，新引入的类别通常仅与少数几个带标签的样本相关。 这一局限性推动了小样本类别增量学习（FSCIL）（Wang 等，2023；Liu 等，2024）的发展，其目标是在极端有限的监督下逐步学习新类别，同时保留先前获得的知识。 与标准 CIL 相比，由于数据稀缺和重复更新，FSCIL 更容易受到灾难性遗忘（McCloskey 和 Cohen，1989）和过拟合（Chen 等，2019）的影响。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, existing FSCIL methods broadly fall into three groups: (i) generative replay methods ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Cheraghian et al., 2021 ; Agarwal et al., 2022 ) , which synthesize additional samples to compensate for limited data; (ii) replay-based methods ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang and Gu, 2023 ; Ji et al., 2023 ) , which retain representative historical samples to alleviate forgetting; and (iii) prompt-based methods ( Liu and Yang, 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , which improve base-session representation learning and facilitate knowledge transfer to incremental stages. Despite their progress, these methods generally rely on a sufficiently large and diverse base session to establish reliable category priors for subsequent adaptation. However, this assumption is often impractical. For example, privacy constraints may leave only a limited number of users available during face-recognition initialization, yielding a weakly structured base-session feature space. Figure 1 (a) shows that class features are scattered and fail to form clear decision boundaries. Consequently, when new classes are introduced, their features can easily overlap with previously occupied regions, leading to severe confusion between old and novel categories. As shown in Figure 1 (b), newly inserted class prototypes can significantly distort existing decision boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，现有的 FSCIL 方法大致可分为三类：(i) 生成式重播方法（Liu et al., 2022; Cheraghian et al., 2021; Agarwal et al., 2022），通过合成额外样本来弥补数据不足；(ii) 基于重播的方法（Li et al., 2024; Zhang and Gu, 2023; Ji et al., 2023），通过保留具有代表性的历史样本来缓解遗忘问题；以及 (iii) 提示 기반 方法（Liu and Yang, 2025; Liu et al., 2024; Jiang et al., 2025），通过改进基础会话中的表示学习，促进知识向增量阶段的迁移。 尽管这些方法取得了进展，但它们通常依赖一个足够大且多样化的基础会话，以便为后续适应建立可靠的类别先验。 然而，这一假设往往不切实际。 例如，隐私限制可能导致人脸识别初始化阶段仅能使用有限数量的用户，从而产生结构松散的基础会话特征空间。 图 1(a) 显示，类别特征分布零散，未能形成清晰的决策边界。 因此，当引入新类别时，其特征很容易与先前已占用的区域重叠，导致旧类别与新类别之间出现严重的混淆。 如图 1(b) 所示，新插入的类别原型可能会显著扭曲现有的决策边界。

paragraphs.en: To investigate this more realistic scenario, we consider a challenging setting termed Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL) , where the base session itself contains only a limited number of classes. A natural way to alleviate supervision scarcity is to leverage synthetic data ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2023 ) , which can enrich intra-class variation and improve prototype estimation. However, naively incorporating synthetic samples often introduces substantial noise. Low-quality generations may cause semantic drift, further disrupt the already fragile feature space, and exacerbate old–new boundary conflicts. This leads to a key question: how can we identify and exploit trustworthy synthetic knowledge to support stable incremental learning under the G-FSCIL setting?

In this way, the model effectively leverages trustworthy synthetic knowledge to complement scarce real data while preserving previously learned decision regions. paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了可泛化的 FSCIL，这是一种更贴近现实的设定：基础会话仅包含有限数量的类别，这会导致类别先验信息较弱，并显著增加后续增量学习的难度。

paragraphs.en: We propose a framework that learns to curate trustworthy synthetic knowledge . It constructs class-specific synthetic candidate pools, learns to select semantically aligned and diverse supports during the base session, and distills this process into a transferable selection policy for later sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种能够学习筛选可信合成知识的框架。 该框架会构建特定类别的合成候选池，在基础阶段学习选择语义一致且多样化的支持信息，并将这一过程提炼为可在后续阶段使用的可迁移选择策略。

sents.en: It constructs class-specific synthetic candidate pools, learns to select semantically aligned and diverse supports during the base session, and distills this process into a transferable selection policy for later sessions.

paragraphs.en: We develop a boundary-stable incremental adaptation strategy that combines synthetic-informed prototype initialization with bidirectional boundary calibration, enabling stable novel-class insertion and mitigating old–new conflicts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种边界稳定的增量自适应策略，该策略将基于合成数据的原型初始化与双向边界校准相结合，从而实现对新类别的稳定插入，并缓解旧类别与新类别之间的冲突。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments show consistent improvements over existing methods with higher accuracy and reduced forgetting.
paragraphs.zh: 大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，本方法在保持更高准确性的同时减少了遗忘，表现持续改进。

paragraphs.en: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning. Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) studies incremental recognition where new classes are introduced with only a few labeled samples. Existing FSCIL methods mainly fall into three categories: (i) classifier or prototype adaptation for novel-class insertion ( Zhang et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) ; (ii) replay and semantic regularization to mitigate forgetting and overfitting ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang and Gu, 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ) ; and (iii) prompt-based transfer with pre-trained vision transformers ( Wang et al., 2022b ; Wang et al., 2022a ; Smith et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Liu and Yang, 2025 ) , together with training-free calibration using multimodal priors ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Recent studies further improve the base feature space by reserving feature capacity, balancing discriminability and transferability, or exploiting stronger vision–language priors ( Ahmed et al., 2024 ; Oh et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2024 ) . Despite these advances, most FSCIL methods assume that the base session provides sufficiently rich category priors, which may not hold in practice. For example, privacy constraints in face recognition can limit the number and diversity of base classes available at initialization. This motivates our study of G-FSCIL, where incremental learning starts from a weak base prior.
paragraphs.zh: 小样本增量类别学习。 小样本增量类别学习（FSCIL）研究增量识别问题，其中新类别仅通过少量带标签的样本引入。 现有的 FSCIL 方法主要可分为三类：(i) 为插入新类别而进行的分类器或原型自适应（Zhang et al., 2021；Zhou et al., 2022；Wang et al., 2023）；(ii) 通过重播和语义正则化来缓解遗忘和过拟合（Li et al., 2024；Zhang and Gu, 2023；Song et al., 2023）；以及 (iii) 结合预训练视觉变换器的提示基迁移（Wang et al., 2022b；Wang et al., 2022a；Smith et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2024；Liu and Yang, 2025），以及利用多模态先验进行无训练校准（Chen et al., 2025）。 近期的研究通过保留特征容量、平衡可区分性与迁移性，或利用更强的视觉-语言先验，进一步改进了基础特征空间（Ahmed et al., 2024；Oh et al., 2024；Park et al., 2024）。 尽管取得了这些进展，大多数 FSCIL 方法仍假设基础会话提供了足够丰富的类别先验，而这一假设在实践中可能并不成立。 例如，人脸识别中的隐私限制可能会限制初始化时可用基础类别的数量和多样性。 这促使我们研究 G-FSCIL，其中增量学习从一个较弱的基先验开始。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-Based Data Generation. Diffusion models have been widely used for data synthesis, augmentation, and replay. Prior work uses them to enrich intra-class variation for prompt tuning ( Feng et al., 2023 ) , alleviate few-shot scarcity via synthesized features or semantic replay ( Cheraghian et al., 2021 ; Agarwal et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2022 ) , and approximate historical data distributions in continual learning ( Gao and Liu, 2023 ) . DDDR ( Liang et al., 2024 ) avoids generator retraining via reusable class inversion, while DiffGRE ( Liu et al., 2025 ) emphasizes synthetic-data refinement. Dataset distillation further shows the importance of informative subset selection over data quantity ( Cazenavette et al., 2022 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) . These results indicate that the key challenge is not generation itself, but ensuring synthetic-data fidelity and utility. Unlike replay-oriented methods that approximate past distributions, our approach builds reusable class-specific knowledge and selectively exploits it under weak base priors.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散的数据生成。 扩散模型已被广泛用于数据合成、增强和重放。 先前的工作利用它们来丰富类内变异性以进行提示调优（Feng 等，2023），通过合成的特征或语义重放缓解少样本稀缺问题（Cheraghian 等，2021；Agarwal 等，2022；Liu 等，2022），以及在持续学习中近似历史数据分布（Gao 和 Liu，2023）。 DDDR（Liang 等，2024）通过可重用的类反转避免了生成器的重新训练，而 DiffGRE（Liu 等，2025）则强调合成数据的优化。 数据集蒸馏进一步表明，相比数据数量，选择信息丰富的子集更为重要（Cazenavette 等，2022；Zhong 等，2025）。 这些结果表明，关键挑战并非生成本身，而是确保合成数据的保真度和实用性。 与旨在重放过去分布的方法不同，我们的方法构建可重用的类特定知识，并在较弱的基先验下选择性地利用它。

paragraphs.en: Data Selection and Synthetic Knowledge Curation. Data selection aims to identify compact yet informative subsets based on importance, coverage, or downstream utility, particularly for synthetic data with varying quality. Recent studies ( Gadre et al., 2023 ; Goyal et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) have shown that data curation is critical for improving training data quality, where effective filtering and relevance-aware selection can be more beneficial than simply increasing data scale or compute. In FSCIL, synthetic data are useful only when they preserve semantic consistency while introducing complementary diversity, as explored through replay ( Zhang and Gu, 2023 ; Agarwal et al., 2022 ) , semantic constraints ( Song et al., 2023 ) , and sample refinement ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Different from these methods, we explicitly learn semantic- and diversity-aware curation during the base session and distill it into a transferable policy that is reused in incremental sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 数据选择与合成知识构建。 数据选择旨在基于重要性、覆盖范围或下游效用，识别紧凑且信息丰富的子集，尤其适用于质量各异的合成数据。 近期研究（Gadre 等人，2023；Goyal 等人，2024；Kim 等人，2025；Wei 等人，2025）表明，数据构建对于提升训练数据质量至关重要，其中有效的筛选和关注相关性的选择，可能比单纯增加数据规模或计算资源更具益处。 在 FSCIL 中，合成数据仅在保持语义一致性的同时引入互补性多样性时才有用，这一点已通过重播（Zhang 和 Gu，2023；Agarwal 等人，2022）、语义约束（Song 等人，2023）以及样本优化（Liu 等人，2025）等方法进行了探索。 与这些方法不同，我们在基础阶段明确学习关注语义和多样性的构建策略，并将其提炼为可迁移的策略，以便在增量阶段重复使用。

paragraphs.en: Problem Setup. Unlike conventional FSCIL settings with a relatively large base-class pool, Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL) considers a more challenging scenario in which the base session contains only a small number of classes and the full task is divided into more incremental sessions. Consequently, the model starts from substantially weaker category priors, and each subsequent session must adapt novel classes under a more challenging incremental process.
paragraphs.zh: 问题设定。 与拥有相对较大基础类别池的传统 FSCIL 设置不同，可泛化的 FSCIL（G-FSCIL）考虑了一种更具挑战性的场景：基础阶段仅包含少量类别，而完整任务则被划分为更多个增量阶段。 因此，模型从明显较弱的类别先验开始，每个后续阶段都必须在更具挑战性的增量过程中适应新类别。

paragraphs.en: Compared with conventional FSCIL, our G-FSCIL provides only limited labeled data in the base session, making the learned class prototypes more vulnerable to bias and instability. Synthetic samples can provide additional within-class variation for observed classes, but low-quality generations may also distort the already formed feature space. We therefore treat synthetic data as a candidate knowledge pool and learn to curate it via a knowledge curation strategy that assigns learnable soft weights to synthetic samples and optimizes them with semantic- and diversity-aware regularization. The resulting curation behavior is further distilled into a transferable trust policy, enabling reliable synthetic knowledge to be reused in subsequent incremental sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 与传统的 FSCIL 相比，我们的 G-FSCIL 在基础阶段仅提供有限的标注数据，这使得学习到的类别原型更容易受到偏差和不稳定性的影响。 合成样本可以为已观察到的类别提供额外的类内变异性，但低质量的生成样本也可能扭曲已经形成的特征空间。 因此，我们将合成数据视为一个候选知识池，并通过一种知识策展策略来学习如何对其进行筛选：该策略为合成样本分配可学习的软权重，并利用关注语义和多样性的正则化方法对其进行优化。 由此产生的策展行为会被进一步提炼成一种可迁移的信任策略，从而使得可靠的合成知识能够在后续的增量阶段被重复利用。

paragraphs.en: In G-FSCIL, the challenge of incremental adaptation lies not only in limited supervision, but also in how to stably integrate few-shot novel classes into a feature space already occupied by previously learned classes. Under such limited supervision, novel-class prototypes are often estimated unreliably, which in turn induces boundary conflicts with old classes during subsequent adaptation. To address this issue, we propose a boundary-stable incremental adaptation strategy. It first performs synthetic-informed prototype initialization from trustworthy synthetic knowledge, and then applies bidirectional boundary calibration to suppress high-risk interference between old and novel classes. In this way, the model can stably adapt to novel classes using sparse real samples together with reliable synthetic knowledge selected by the learned policy.
paragraphs.zh: 在 G-FSCIL 中，增量适应的挑战不仅在于监督有限，还在于如何将小样本的新类别稳定地整合到已被先前学习的类别占据的特征空间中。 在这种有限的监督条件下，新类别的原型往往难以可靠估计，这反过来又会在后续适应过程中引发与旧类别之间的边界冲突。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种边界稳定的增量适应策略。 该策略首先基于可信的合成知识执行合成引导的原型初始化，然后应用双向边界校准，以抑制旧类别与新类别之间的高风险干扰。 通过这种方式，模型能够利用稀疏的真实样本以及由已学习策略筛选出的可靠合成知识，稳定地适应新类别。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional boundary calibration. Although synthetic-informed prototype initialization provides a more reliable starting point for novel classes, few-shot adaptation can still introduce local conflicts between old and novel classes. Current novel samples may be biased toward semantically similar old classes, while adaptation to new classes can disturb the decision regions of previously learned classes. We therefore perform a local boundary refinement that selectively enlarges the margins for risky interactions in the novel-to-old and old-to-novel directions.

In contrast to conventional FSCIL settings with a large base session, our protocol adopts a significantly smaller base-class pool, resulting in substantially weaker initial priors and a more realistic yet challenging evaluation scenario. paragraphs.en: Implementation details. We adopt a ViT-B/16 backbone ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ) pretrained on ImageNet-1K ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) for all experiments. All input images are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 to align with the input resolution of the ViT backbone and the synthetic generation pipeline. Synthetic samples are produced with a latent diffusion model pretrained on LAION-400M ( Schuhmann et al., 2021 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) . For each class, we optimize a class-specific condition embedding via class inversion for 5 rounds with 50 steps, and generate M syn = 200 M_{\mathrm{syn}}=200 candidate samples. The base session is trained with both real and synthetic samples for 10 epochs, with learning rates of 0.01, 0.05, and 0.02 on CIFAR100, CUB200, and ImageNet-R, respectively. The target within-pool selection fraction is dataset-specific, with ρ sel = 0.01 \rho_{\mathrm{sel}}=0.01 for CIFAR100 and ImageNet-R, and ρ sel = 0.001 \rho_{\mathrm{sel}}=0.001 for CUB200. Synthetic trustworthiness is estimated by an MLP-based policy scorer. During incremental sessions, optimization is performed using current real samples and old synthetic samples, while novel synthetic samples are used exclusively for prototype enhancement. The classifier head is frozen during incremental fine-tuning. Each incremental session is trained for 10 epochs with a learning rate of 0.01. We set the prototype fusion coefficient to ρ c = 0.1 \rho_{c}=0.1 and the calibration margin to δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 .

paragraphs.en: Our method achieves the best performance on both ImageNet-R and CIFAR100. On ImageNet-R, it improves AvgAcc to 70.7 and HAcc to 65.4, while reducing PD to 28.0. These results demonstrate a clear advantage in balancing stability and plasticity under the low-base setting. On CIFAR100, our method further achieves an AvgAcc of 86.9, an HAcc of 84.2, and a PD of 20.4, surpassing the strongest baseline SEC-Prompt by margins of 8.7, 15.4, and 10.8, respectively. As shown in Fig. 3 , our method consistently maintains higher accuracy across sessions with a flatter degradation trend, indicating stronger resistance to long-term forgetting. This advantage becomes more pronounced in the middle and later stages, where accumulated old-new interference is more severe. Overall, these results confirm the effectiveness of leveraging trustworthy synthetic knowledge under weak base priors, yielding more reliable prototype initialization and more stable boundary preservation throughout incremental learning.

paragraphs.en: Component Ablation. Table 4 evaluates the contributions of trustworthy synthetic knowledge curation (TSKC) and boundary-stable incremental adaptation (BSIA). TSKC alone consistently improves the baseline on both CIFAR100 and CUB200, showing that semantically aligned and diverse synthetic samples are already beneficial under weak base priors. In contrast, BSIA alone brings limited gains on CIFAR100 and is less stable on CUB200, indicating that its prototype and boundary calibration depends on a reliable base representation. paragraphs.en: Trustworthiness of the Learned Selection Policy. We compare our learned selection policy against three alternatives: random selection, Moderate Coreset ( Xia et al., 2023 ) , and a forgetting-based strategy ( Toneva et al., 2018 ) . As shown in Fig. 5 , our policy consistently outperforms all three baselines throughout the incremental process, with especially clear gains in the middle and late sessions. This trend suggests that the learned selector captures transferable cues of synthetic trustworthiness, rather than relying on a session-specific heuristic. By contrast, the forgetting-based strategy performs substantially worse, suggesting that selection without explicit semantic reliability can damage the learned base geometry.

Fig. 6 shows that synthetic-informed prototype initialization moves the synthetic-informed novel prototype away from old-class high-density regions relative to the few-shot real prototype, indicating that trustworthy synthetic supports primarily correct the initial point of novel classes rather than merely enlarge the training set. This geometric correction reduces the chance that a new class is inserted directly into a confusion region.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we study G-FSCIL, a challenging setting where the base session provides only weak priors for subsequent few-shot adaptation. We show that its key difficulty lies not only in data scarcity, but also in exploiting trustworthy synthetic knowledge without disrupting old–new decision boundaries. To address this, we propose a unified framework that combines trustworthy synthetic knowledge curation with boundary-stable incremental adaptation, enabling reliable support selection, robust novel-class initialization, and stable old–new separation. Extensive experiments on CIFAR100, CUB200, and ImageNet-R demonstrate consistent improvements over existing FSCIL methods, particularly under long-horizon incremental learning with weak base priors.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了 G-FSCIL——一种具有挑战性的设定，其中基础会话仅为后续的少样本自适应提供弱先验知识。 我们发现，其关键难点不仅在于数据稀缺，还在于如何有效利用可信的合成知识，同时避免破坏旧有与新增决策边界。 为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种统一框架，将可信合成知识的构建与边界稳定的增量自适应相结合，从而实现可靠的支撑选择、稳健的新类别初始化以及稳定的新旧分离。 在 CIFAR100、CUB200 和 ImageNet-R 上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法相较于现有的 FSCIL 方法表现更优，尤其是在长期增量学习且基础先验较弱的场景下。

paragraphs.en: Table S2 reports detailed comparisons with representative FSCIL methods on CUB200. Our method achieves the best overall performance, reaching 80.9 AvgAcc, 79.9 HAcc, and 20.2 PD. Compared with the strongest prior baseline ASP, our method improves AvgAcc by 3.3 points while further reducing PD by 0.3. Compared with SEC-Prompt, it brings gains of 4.5 points in AvgAcc and 4.2 points in HAcc, together with a 2.5-point reduction in PD. Although the proposed method does not achieve the highest base-session accuracy, it consistently outperforms prior approaches from the first incremental session onward, indicating a more favorable balance between plasticity and long-term stability.

paragraphs.en: On CIFAR100 , TSKC already serves as the most effective single component, achieving 78.99 AvgAcc and 77.92 HAcc. This demonstrates that trustworthy synthetic knowledge curation in the base stage is essential for stabilizing the low-base regime. Adding Si-PI on top of TSKC further improves performance to 79.87 AvgAcc and 79.68 HAcc, while also achieving the best old-class accuracy (93.80), indicating improved representation stability and old-class preservation. In contrast, combining TSKC with Bi-BC leads to a larger gain in incremental performance, boosting AvgAcc to 86.36 and HAcc to 83.46, and achieving the best new-class accuracy (78.42). This suggests that once reliable synthetic knowledge has been established, boundary calibration becomes particularly effective in resolving old–new conflicts during incremental adaptation. Finally, integrating all three components yields the best overall result, reaching 86.89 AvgAcc, 84.23 HAcc, and 20.37 PD.

paragraphs.en: On CUB200 , the ablation exhibits a more delicate pattern due to the fine-grained nature of the dataset. Configurations that introduce synthetic-assisted incremental adaptation without TSKC are highly unstable, leading to extremely low old-class accuracy and HAcc. This directly shows that, on fine-grained data, uncurated synthetic knowledge can be harmful and that trustworthy curation is a necessary prerequisite for subsequent incremental use. Once TSKC is enabled, performance improves dramatically: TSKC alone reaches 78.36 AvgAcc and 81.80 HAcc, already establishing a strong baseline. Adding Si-PI on top of TSKC further improves HAcc to 82.02 and old-class accuracy to 90.53, indicating that synthetic-informed prototype initialization is particularly beneficial for stabilizing fine-grained class insertion and preserving previously learned categories. By contrast, combining TSKC with Bi-BC yields the best new-class accuracy (75.84) and the lowest PD (18.76), while also improving AvgAcc to 80.25, suggesting that boundary calibration is more effective in enhancing plasticity and reducing performance degradation. When all three components are jointly used, the model achieves the best AvgAcc of 80.44 while maintaining competitive HAcc, old-class accuracy, and new-class accuracy, demonstrating the strongest overall end-to-end configuration.

paragraphs.en: Overall, these results are consistent with the design of our method. paragraphs.en: Figure S2 compares the discriminative regions highlighted by ASP, SEC-Prompt, and our method. paragraphs.zh: C.3. 超参数敏感性分析。

sents.en: Hyperparameter Sensitivity Analysis.

paragraphs.en: We further study the sensitivity of the proposed method to the calibration margin δ \delta and the diversity weight λ div \lambda_{\mathrm{div}} , as shown in Fig. S3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们还研究了所提方法对校准余量 δ \delta 和多样性权重 λ div \lambda_{\mathrm{div}} 的敏感性，如图 S3 所示。

paragraphs.en: For the calibration margin δ \delta , both AvgAcc and HAcc first improve and then gradually decline as δ \delta increases. The best overall performance is achieved around δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 , where both metrics reach their peak or near-peak values. When δ \delta becomes larger, the performance drops steadily, and the degradation becomes more evident after δ ≥ 0.6 \delta\geq 0.6 . This suggests that a moderate margin is sufficient to encourage effective boundary calibration, whereas an excessively large margin tends to over-separate classes and harm the stability–plasticity trade-off. We therefore set δ = 0.1 \delta=0.1 in all experiments.
